description: Defines structures, macros, and functions for handling network timeouts with wrap-around support in Zephyr OS.

methods.name: net_timeout_set
methods.description: Configures a network timeout structure with specified lifetime and start time.

methods.name: net_timeout_deadline
methods.description: Returns the 64-bit system time at which the timeout will expire.

methods.name: net_timeout_remaining
methods.description: Calculates the remaining time to the timeout in seconds.

methods.name: net_timeout_evaluate
methods.description: Updates timeout state based on elapsed time and determines next delay.
